Libraries

Mamie Doud Eisenhower Public Library: Hours, Location and What's There

Photo by HonjuTheCat / Wikimedia Commons (CC0)

Broomfield's public library, named for Mamie Doud Eisenhower at the community's request. The current building opened November 10, 2001. Broomfield's only library location. Address: 3 Community Park Road, Broomfield, CO 80020. It's open Mon–Thu 9am–9pm, Fri–Sat 9am–5pm, Sun 1pm–5pm. Phone: (720) 887-2300.
